title: Náhradní sladidla ve výživě člověka
publisher: Česká zemědělská univerzita v Praze / Theses.cz
claims_supported: 284 adult questionnaire respondents and 14 sensory assessors; aqueous sweetener rankings
limitations: Non-peer-reviewed; tiny sensory panel; not finished beverage preference or representative prevalence

title: The Development and Consumer Acceptance of Functional Fruit-Herbal Beverages
claims_supported: 60 adult consumers; aronia more accepted than sea buckthorn; sugar and steviol-glycoside variants not significantly different within tested matrices
limitations: 80-percent juice matrices; small urban convenience sample; health information supplied; laboratory tasting not purchase or full-serving repeat

title: Distinct Sensory Hedonic Functions for Sourness in Adults
claims_supported: 350 Italian and 143 US adults; heterogeneous sour-liking response patterns across citric-acid pear-juice and water models
limitations: Convenience samples; different matrices and cohorts; not Czech preference prevalence or formulation target; issue date July 2024

title: Sweet Tooth: Nature or Nurture? Assessing the role of dietary sweetness exposure on sweet taste liking
claims_supported: 180 healthy adults; six-month altered whole-diet sweetness exposure did not significantly change sweet-taste preference
limitations: Whole-diet intervention not a particular RTD or Czech customer sample; institutional thesis abstract reviewed

title: Predicting consumer preferences for mineral composition of bottled and tap water
geographic_scope: Spain-based study of French and Spanish waters
claims_supported: 69 volunteers rated 25 waters; liking related to mineral composition with calcium bicarbonate and sulfate preferred over sodium chloride in sample
limitations: Participant residence not established by accessible abstract; water matrix not functional fruit beverage; issue date 2017-01-01

title: CANS+ Performance 24 x 330ml
claims_supported: Raspberry sparkling 330ml can; ingredient list; unsweetened positioning
limitations: Brand efficacy claims not verified; physical label not inspected; fibre table and ingredient list require reconciliation

title: Vilgain Energy & Focus Drink citron a limetka 330ml
claims_supported: Can and direct-consumption format; lemon-lime formula with steviol glycosides magnesium malate and tea; declared 106mg caffeine per can; one-pack daily instruction
limitations: Page interleaves mango and lemon-lime variants; ingredient claims not efficacy; exact purchased batch must be checked

title: Magnesia PLUS – jemně perlivá funkční voda s hořčíkem a vitamíny B
claims_supported: Focus apricot passionfruit ginseng and Antistress mango lemon balm flavours; lightly sparkling; declared 2.4g sugars per 100ml
limitations: Brand claims not measured sensory liking or acute functional effect; page image alt text has inconsistent herb names so body copy used

title: Produkty Magnesia – přírodní minerální vody s hořčíkem
claims_supported: Plus 0.7l pack and still mineral-water 0.5l option; sparkling and still range
limitations: Not local prevalence or taste winner; exact physical bottle and label must be checked

title: TONIC water LIPOVÝ KVĚT & BAZALKA
claims_supported: 200ml linden basil tonic; quinine ginger and lemon concentrate ingredient list; declared sugars
limitations: Formula differs from shop page on pectin/lemon concentrate and order; no independent taste panel

title: Tonic (Lipový květ & Bazalka) 200 ml - 18 ks
claims_supported: 200ml glass bottle; EAN 8594186831142; linden basil ginger quinine and pectin ingredients
